The longest crude oil pipeline in Africa spans across 2 countries at approximately 1,950 meters. The Niger-Benin Oil Pipeline connects the Agadem oilfields in eastern Niger to the Sémé-Kraké terminal on the Atlantic coast of the Republic of Benin.
